mapper.select: SELECT s.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Sign_Score s LEFT JOIN Activity a ON s.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.sign_id = #{signId}

SELECT s.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Sign_Score s LEFT JOIN Activity a ON s.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY s.sign_time DESC

SELECT s.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Sign_Score s LEFT JOIN Activity a ON s.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.sign_time DESC

SELECT s.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Sign_Score s LEFT JOIN Activity a ON s.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.activity_id = #{activityId} AND s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sign_Score WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score), 0) FROM Sign_Score WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Sign_Score(activity_id, user_id, sign_time, score) VALUES(#{activityId}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{score})
